sentences.text: The evidence does not show a replacement for the Key Facts Statement after its 2025 withdrawal from the RBI circular list.
For this UCB, the in-force directions still require a Key Facts Statement in the standardised Annex XIII format for prospective borrowers.
The in-force UCB directions also require the KFS to include the APR computation sheet and the amortisation schedule.

missing.searched: searched the provided RBI withdrawal finding and the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions for any stated successor to the Key Facts Statement; none was identified in the evidence
